properties.name: A design says whether a real test result has ever come back into it
properties.statement: Wherever a session reads the design's status, the design shall state whether any real run has ever been compared against its recorded checks, how many were compared, when last, and whether a failure has ever come back — so a design whose every pass was typed reads differently from one whose passes were confirmed by a run. It states the fact and never counts it against the owner: feeding results back is their choice.
